home_prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Original Japanese website homepage proposal for 民宿ヤマト, inn opposite JR二見浦駅 in 伊勢市. EXACT canvas 1536x864 16:9. Show desktop webpage at left and readable mobile webpage at right. Main improvement: phone and email contact info are fully readable within mobile width, vertically stacked instead of wide table. Calm sky blue, warm pale yellow, white, clear Japanese typography. Header 「民宿ヤマト」. Hero headline 「二見浦駅前の、くつろぎの宿。」. Use an original artistic illustration of gentle sea and sky, not an actual building/room or landscape claim. Sections 「館内のご案内」「お料理」「アクセス」 plus prominent 「ご予約・お問い合わせ」 contact area. Correct general telephone 「0596-43-2215」 and button 「メールで問い合わせる」. Mobile has vertical contact cards fitting width. Do NOT include dogs or mascot: the actual mascot died, so no dog. Do not invent facilities, prices, discounts, reviews, ratings, response times, availability. No booking confirmation. No forms. Clearly show 「非公式デザイン案」 and 「イラストはイメージです」. This illustration-based layout must be polished and inviting but restrained. All typography sharp and legible; fully-contained 16:9 board.
inquiry_prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Reference homepage image is visual style reference only. Create a separate contact-information webpage for 民宿ヤマト with matching sky blue, pale yellow, ivory, delicate watercolor sea border. EXACT 1536x864 16:9. Large desktop page left and mobile page right, fully contained. Title 「ご予約・お問い合わせ」. Core improvement: contact info in vertically stacked cards on mobile, fully readable, no wide table. Phone card 「お電話」 「0596-43-2215」. Email card 「メールでのお問い合わせ」 「m-yamato@k5.dion.ne.jp」 and blue CTA 「メールで問い合わせる」. Email must be exact and fit at comfortable text size. Note 「お名前とお電話番号をお知らせください」. Address card 「所在地」 「三重県伊勢市二見町茶屋9-7」. Link 「館内のご案内に戻る」. White background and ample space. Use only a subtle abstract sea watercolor decoration, no rooms, buildings, dogs, map, or food. Do not add forms, opening hours, prices, response promises, guarantees, booking completion, fake ratings. Visible labels 「非公式デザイン案」 「イラストはイメージです」. Use correct company name phone email repeated identically in mobile and desktop.
review: Company name, phone, email, mobile wrapping and unofficial illustrative labels visually verified.
